Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-prompt-medium-0141", "row_sha256": "1a4ebf27635dd5361ba09021c3936cf58c42463450b63b659174609f13616cd9", "mode": "/prompt", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Organize the supplied request into a clear prompt. Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "hey, could you put together a lighting setup plan for our small crew for the friday staged reading at the mill room? we have the house plot already and i don't want that changed. the side-stage fixtures are the only part that might need a different setup. if the spare dimmer rack gets delivered by tuesday at noon, use it for those fixtures. if it has not arrived by then, leave them on the current rack and use only two side-stage fixtures. please make both options clear in the plan, not just the one you think is more likely. include a short checklist for labeling cables and checking focus before rehearsal, and show where the crew should confirm which rack is available. we have volunteer operators, so keep the steps straightforward and don't assume everyone knows the room. no gear purchases or changes to the rest of the house plot; i'm only asking for a plan we can review before the setup call.", "output": "Create a straightforward lighting setup plan for our small crew for the Friday staged reading at the Mill Room. The existing house plot must remain unchanged; only the side-stage fixtures may need a different setup.

Include both of these options clearly:
- If the spare dimmer rack is delivered by Tuesday at noon, use it for the side-stage fixtures.
- If it has not arrived by then, keep the side-stage fixtures on the current rack and use only two of them.

Add a short checklist for labeling cables and checking focus before rehearsal. Include where the crew should confirm which rack is available. Keep the steps accessible to volunteer operators who may not know the room. Do not include gear purchases or changes to the rest of the house plot. This is a plan for review before the setup call."}]
